_comment: Orders can only be created through POST /api/orders/checkout (there is no direct order-insert endpoint), so this file describes checkout scenarios rather than raw order rows. seed.js replays each scenario against the matching user's cart from dummy-data/carts/carts.json.

scenarios.note: Happy path: cart has 2x Deluxe Widget + 1x Wireless Mechanical Keyboard, charge succeeds, stock decrements, cart clears.
Decline path: order is created but marked PAYMENT_FAILED, stock is left untouched, and the cart survives so the customer can retry with a different token.
